title: teucrium polium subsp. eriocephalum
intro: Teucrium polium subsp. eriocephalum, commonly known as wild marjoram, is a subspecies of the perennial herb Teucrium polium. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Teucrium polium subsp. eriocephalum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to treat wounds, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, spasmolytic, and expectorant effects, which can help to calm the nervous system, relax muscles, and relieve respiratory issues, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as thujone and camphor.
